body.statement: For every \(L\ge2\), \(\dim(Q_{3,L})=3L\). For every \(L\ge3\), the construction in \(\text{def:staircase-family}\) maps the \(3^{L-3}\) words ending in \(\mathrm D\) injectively into \(\mathcal W_L\); the all-\(\mathrm D\) word has coefficients \(2^j-1\), and alternating \(\mathrm L\) and \(\mathrm R\) prefixes attain \(\operatorname{Fib}(L)-1\) at the last common endpoint coefficient.
body.justification: The family supplies an exponential lower bound, explicit weighted facets, and the mandatory encoding stress test.
body.gap: Bonet2001 establishes a causal facet precedent, but no published result exhibits this non-valley staircase family or its Fibonacci and doubling subfamilies.
body.consumer: Any claimed complete generator or coefficient-size bound can be falsified immediately on this explicit family.
